name: PORTRAIT
description:
PORTRAIT (2023)

I'm standing in front of a mirror. Looking at the painting palette, as if the colors on it represent me and my deepest emotions. The dim light was more than enough to make all the smoke coming out of my cigarette seen. As I inhaled, I started to have hits with my brush on the canvas, like I was exhaling on it. I could see myself creating something; it was when I suddenly stopped painting.

Was I the result or was it me that wanted to have this result? I, then, leaned in to have my lips roam on the reflection, and it was when it started to slowly fade out.

name: GET AWAY FROM ME
description:
GET AWAY FROM ME (2023)

I cannot find myself a place to go. I cannot run away anymore. I do want to be free… From my thoughts and their manifestations. 

I don't know how much longer I can endure, nor do I know how much farther I can go. My mind gets numb, so it gets harder for me to think and imagine. I feel surrounded even though I used to feel devoted. Only if everybody remained silent, then could I be more resilient. Nothing is clean; there are stains everywhere. I am not the guy, once was innocent and free.

The consequences capture me. All I can do is to try…Try to find a way out.

name: MANIFESTATION
description:
MANIFESTATION (2023)

We feel from the depths of our roots. No matter how much we try to hide them, it is inevitable for them to make it to the surface. 

Hatred is red but lust is black. Hope is blue and purity is white. One way or another, they will manifest. They will face you and you will have to pay your penance. Nothing stays neither the same nor unreturned. 

Your actions have their consequences. 

Similar to John Locke’s tabula rasa… At first, your tally is all empty. It gets filled with emotions as time passes. Though you may not realize, you are the manifestation itself.

name: SOULMATE

SOULMATE (2023)

You see your emotions overlap with one another. That is when you find your soulmate.
